description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git svn useSvmProps' feature, involving SVN repository setup, configuration, and verification of commit metadata. It automates a sequence of SVN and Git commands to perform integration tests related to SVN metadata handling within Git.

methods.name: load svm repo
methods.description: Loads an SVN dump into the repository and initializes multiple SVN remotes within Git, then configures Git to use SVN properties and fetches all SVN data.

methods.name: verify metadata for /bar
methods.description: Checks that the commits in refs/remotes/bar contain the correct SVN IDs corresponding to the SVN revisions.

methods.name: verify metadata for /dir/a/b/c/d/e
methods.description: Verifies that the commit for the specified SVN path has the correct SVN ID.

methods.name: verify metadata for /dir
methods.description: Checks that commits for the directory path contain expected SVN IDs.

methods.name: find commit based on SVN revision number
methods.description: Uses 'git svn find-rev' to locate the commit corresponding to a specific SVN revision.

methods.name: empty rebase
methods.description: Performs a 'git svn rebase' to ensure a clean state.
